tools.description: OCR tool for capturing and extracting text from screen regions or images
tools.usage: Capture2Text.exe # Launch GUI OCR tool\nUse hotkeys to capture screen regions and extract text to clipboard\nSupports multiple languages and text recognition

tools.description: Command-line OCR tool for automated text extraction from images
tools.usage: Capture2Text_CLI.exe -i image.png -o output.txt # Extract text from image\nCapture2Text_CLI.exe --lang japanese -i scan.jpg # OCR with specific language\nCapture2Text_CLI.exe --help # Show all options
